scope: new development seed; query reduction and temporal source grouping discriminants
fixed_resource: 1760 original source tokens per head of one selected 7040-token bank
online_inputs: uniform32 current Q samples; source group K/V means formed at past scene close; group counts
query_peak_formula: u=p*norm(meanV); score=max_q u/sum_g(u), with FP32 tiny protecting zero denominator
time_groups: same 2x4 source spatial patch over8 past frames;110 groups64 tokens; contiguous64 comparator has same counts
lifetime: first return chunk; per-layer route frozen across four denoising steps and clean
record_separately: GPU resident and peak temporary memory
quality_contract: shared pre-return actual latents and decoded RGB; each case own source/away/return/late review
promotion: diagnostic closed-loop evidence only; no formal holdout or repeated speedup claim
